name: focus-field
description: Locate the current field, derive the question that matters, and keep the next move valid as evidence changes.

interface.shortDescription: Locate your field and ask what matters
interface.longDescription: Focus turns an unclear, overloaded, or changing situation into a field-relative position, a governing question, and one valid next move, then revises that position as evidence changes.
defaultPrompt: Use Focus to locate my situation and find the question that matters now.
Use Focus to turn this broad research topic into one governing question.
Use Focus to keep this changing project aligned as evidence changes.
